description: K562 13d prediction contract. Perturbed TFs: CREB1, E2F4, EGR1, ELF1, ELK1, ETS1, GABPA, IRF1, NR2C2, YY1. Target set is context-local (dataset-local 10-TF leave-one-out), not atlas-shared with HCC.
scoring_gene_universe_note: GEARS: full 45-gene atlas-space output (complete prediction universe). Embedding-based entrants: genome-wide output restricted to atlas-overlapping gene subset. These universes are NOT identical; raw Spearman values are not strictly comparable across entrant families.

GEARS.note: GEARS outputs exactly 45 atlas gene columns, which is its complete prediction output space for this task

paper_role: formal supplementary external model-side panel (K562 13d primary timepoint)
context_local_note: K562 target set is context-local and not atlas-shared with HCC. This entrant layer supports architecture-form external recurrence, trade-off partial recurrence diagnostic, and temporal stratification analysis. It is NOT a target-overlap replication of HCC atlas genes.
